pages.text: $(#FF6B6B)🍓 Sun & Moon Berry · Frost Covenant ❄️$()$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)「A sip of starlight and sunlight fused together, granting elemental blessings to mortal flesh」$()$(br)The vitality of $(#FF6B6B)Sunberry$(), the wisdom of $(#9370DB)Starlight Berry$(), the icy purity of $(#87CEEB)Everfrost Crystal$(), and the sweetness of $(#DAA520)Amber Syrup$() swirl within the $(#6A5ACD)Moonlight Shaker$()—creating a mystical forest elixir that grants $(l)Fire Resistance$(), $(l)Night Vision$(), and $(l)Regeneration$().

$(#FF6B6B)▌ Triple Elemental Blessings $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💖 Berry Pulse$()$(br)Wounds glow with $(#FF6B6B)berry-shaped light patterns$() as they heal.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🛡 Dragon Scale Membrane$()$(br)Skin develops $(#CD5C5C)translucent dragon scales$(), shielding against heat.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🌌 Starlight Filter$()$(br)Pupils shimmer with $(#9370DB)galactic radiance$(), piercing through darkness.

$(br2)$(#9370DB)▌ Moonlight Crafting $()$(br)- Dry $(#FF6B6B)Sweet Berries$() and $(#9370DB)Glow Berries$() into shrunken spheres.$(br)- Carve $(#87CEEB)Ice Blocks$() into $(#B0E0E6)Snowflake Crystals$().$(br)- Shake the mixture with $(#DAA520)Honey$() as the base, performing $(#00BFFF)seven ice shakes$().$(br2)$(#7FFFD4)※$() A perfect blend will display $(#FF6B6B)layered auroras$() and $(#9370DB)star-like sparkles$().

$(br2)$(#6A5ACD)『 Elven Ice Cellar Inscription 』$()$(br)An ancient carving on tree roots:$(br)'When $(#FF6B6B)Red Berries$() absorb $(#DAA520)hundred-day sunlight$(),$(br)and $(#9370DB)Yellow Berries$() condense $(#00BFFF)moonlight essence$() overnight,$(br)the drinker shall inherit:$(br)- $(#FF4500)Lizard Fireproof Scales$()$(br)- $(#4169E1)Owl’s Nocturnal Vision$()$(br)- $(#FF69B4)Tree Spirit’s Vitality$()$(br)However, avoid consuming this during a $(#9370DB)Lunar Eclipse$(),$(br)or else the $(#6A5ACD)Starlight Filter$() may transform into a $(#000000)Curse of Eternal Night$()'.
